title: Aseity of God
definition: The aseity of God means that God is from Himself, sufficient in Himself, and possesses all life, glory, goodness, and blessedness in Himself.
summary: God is complete and sufficient in Himself, needing nothing from creation.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the fullness of divine life and grace, giving from God's abundance to needy sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Aseity teaches that God is not completed by creation. He did not create because He was lonely, lacking, or dependent. He has all life and fullness in Himself.

This doctrine humbles human pride. People cannot place God in debt or make Him dependent on their service. All things come from Him, through Him, and to Him.

Yet the self-sufficient God gives generously. The Gospel is not God receiving what He lacks, but God giving mercy from His fullness in Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think of worship or service as though God needs them. Aseity matters because it shows that God's love and grace are free, not driven by lack.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Serve God with gratitude rather than pride. Remember that He is not needy, and receive His gifts as mercy rather than wages.
